short_description: The S&P 500 and Bitcoin in large digits, gains in green and losses in red.
description:
## What you see

The price in large digits, and on the left the name and the day's change after an up or down arrow. Gains are green, losses red. The S&P 500 and Bitcoin take turns every five seconds.

## Data

Yahoo Finance for the S&P 500 and [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/api) for Bitcoin, no keys needed, checked every five minutes.
